OP

Fully exiting XMR.
CPU mining is a weak security model. A single pool already pushed serious hashrate at the chain. A nation-state does not need a new idea, just more machines. The cost of a majority attack is hardware you can rent, not a factory you have to build.
No crypto agility. The protocol cannot swap out its cryptography without a slow, contentious hard fork. Quantum is not the only threat that requires that. If the math breaks, there is no clean upgrade path, and the old chain stays readable.
No liquidity. You can barely buy or sell it. Institutions will not touch a coin they cannot custody, list, or exit. No new money, no bid. Privacy without a market is just a bag you cannot leave.
The reputation does not help either. Congrats on sticking to principles, but I care more about making money.
